name.value: Prestige Treasure Cove Resort Prince George

description.value: The Prestige Treasure Cove Resort is a full-service hotel and resort on Highway 97 in Prince George, BC, offering standard rooms, suites, and designer rooms alongside an on-site casino, pool with waterslide and hot tub, and athletic centre. Prince George is a major waypoint for cyclists traveling the Highway 97 corridor through central BC. The property is dog-friendly and part of the Prestige Hotels & Resorts chain with 19 locations across British Columbia.

address.value: 2005 Hwy 97 S, Prince George, BC V2N 7A3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is well-populated and confirms the property is actively operating as of May 2025. The website consistently refers to the property as 'Prestige Treasure Cove Resort Prince George' rather than OSM's 'Prestige Treasure Cove Hotel', a notable name discrepancy. No cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, e-bike charging, tools, laundry) are mentioned anywhere in the website text; however, 'Complimentary High Speed Wi-Fi' and an on-site restaurant and cafe are explicitly confirmed as hotel features.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records 'Prestige Treasure Cove Hotel' but the website consistently uses 'Prestige Treasure Cove Resort Prince George' — the word 'Hotel' vs 'Resort' is a meaningful difference.
Address labeling differs: OSM has '2005 Cariboo Highway'; website contact page shows '2005 Hwy 97 S Prince George, BC V2N 7A3' (same road, different common name used).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate full-service hotel in a key Highway 97 cycling hub, but no cycling-specific amenities or bike storage are mentioned anywhere on the website; direct contact is needed to confirm the WWC required criteria before listing.
